(4) HYPOTHESIS: at the iter-4 joint optimum a seed flip 42->123 reseeds the warm-start U-Net init + per-scan Adam; expect hr WITHIN the seed noise band of 0.1976 (the warm-start anchors the basin, so the Mayo 2304-view floor should be far tighter than the demo synthetic floor). NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if hr <= 0.19761 (within noise, no systematic gain), hr 0.1976 @iter-4 is CONFIRMED as the per-image U-Net N2I half-view ceiling on dense 2304-view Mayo -- document it (NAF/ram structural-negative class) toward iter-20, no further per-image tuning. (If hr somehow > 0.1976 by > seed-noise, the iter-4 read was seed-lucky-low and the ceiling is slightly higher -- still a ceiling, just re-anchored.) (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min compute, val=ALL 214): seed changes NO per-step cost; config == iter-4 (measured elapsed 1235.5s). Fit loop 214x18x0.2557=985s + overhead ~267s (warm-start 4ep + setup/score) = ~1252s figure-inclusive, well under the 1800s/30-min SLURM hard wall. Per-scene 4.60s < per_scene_s=1080/214=5.05s -> NO truncation, outer_wall_s stays 1080. grad_clip=1.0 mandatory (2304-view FBP adjoint overflows otherwise). val_n=214 NOT reduced (protocol). 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov=False). staged_canonical / v3 mayo_ldct_fitted / per-sample-ps half-angle projector swap / bg_target=truth hard-wired.
